summary.text: Christine Sinicki is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 20, where she took office in 1999, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Kyle Cleary.
She previously served on the Milwaukee School Board from 1991 to 1998.

paragraphs.text: Christine Sinicki served on the Milwaukee School Board from 1991 to 1998 and was a delegate to the Electoral College in 2000.
She assumed office in the Wisconsin State Assembly in 1999.
For 2025-2026 her committee assignments were State Affairs, Veterans and Military Affairs, and Workforce Development.
